credits_spent: trial; 7 days left, no credits shown

criterion_notes.D1: There is no password login. Softr sends a one-time code to the email address instead, so the demo account from the brief cannot be used with a password.
criterion_notes.D7: A wrong code shows "That code didn't work. Try again." and a search without matches shows an empty state with Clear filters.
criterion_notes.D12: axe found five issues: colour contrast (serious, 9 nodes), a main landmark that is not top level, a duplicate main landmark, a non-unique landmark and four nodes outside landmarks.

failures: D1: the demo account password is not implemented — login is email-code only.
D12: colour contrast fails on nine nodes, plus landmark structure (axe).
notes: Softr built a working internal tool from one prompt: 20 seeded bookings, search that drives a URL parameter, a working status filter (10 of 20 Confirmed), a detail page per booking with a Back to list link, an editable notes field that really saves, and a CSV export with 21 lines. It added a service filter nobody asked for. The gap against the brief is the login: Softr only does email codes, so a demo password cannot exist. The design is the calmest of the four, but accessibility suffers — nine colour-contrast failures on the table badges.

pricing.free_plan: Free trial (7 days left at test time); publishes to a free mysoftr.app domain
